neutral_summary: LD 1459 expanded state agricultural bargaining law to forest-products harvesters and haulers; enacted as Public Law 2019 chapter 248.
LD 1874 concerning labor standards for loggers and truckers became Public Law chapter 380 without the Governor's signature; amendments changed its title and provisions.
Jackson appealed a Legislative Council rejection of a request to introduce LR 2951, which sought to prevent clear-cutting on specified public lands in Allagash; an appeal is not enactment.
Collins and Jared Golden introduced the Loggers Economic Assistance and Relief Act to establish disaster-loss assistance for qualifying loggers. Introduction does not establish enactment.

Collins announced that a Senate committee-approved FY2025 Interior and Environment appropriations proposal included $6 million for the Northeastern States Research Cooperative and $6 million for the Community Forest and Open Space Conservation Program. Committee advancement is not final enactment.

Collins's official Senate office reported that $200 million for timber harvesters and haulers was included in federal pandemic relief legislation and described Maine applications to the PATHH program. Date is the approximate reporting period; confirm exact publication date and figures before site display.
